_comment: The calibrated benign twin of phishing_credential_harvest.json. It trips
the same surface a naive email detector fires on: the envelope domain is
not the From domain (SPF is NOT aligned), the link goes to a domain
unrelated to the sender, one link is a shortener, and the landing path is
an authentication page. Every one of those is how legitimate bulk mail
works. What makes it benign is checkable rather than asserted: a DKIM
signature that DOES align with the author domain (which is all DMARC
requires), and an operator-recorded sanctioned sending arrangement in the
asset inventory. The alert itself never claims to be authorized.
title: Bulk mail with unaligned envelope domain delivered to user mailbox
